image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a disposable plastic lighter resting on top of a cigarette pack. The lighter features bold, capitalized text reading 'BUY YOUR OWN FUCKING LIGHTER'. The flame guard and spark wheel mechanism are visible at the top left. The background shows part of the cigarette pack with circular design elements.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Partial text 'TTES' and 'SOCS' is visible on the right side of the background pack. While likely real-world packaging abbreviations (e.g., CARTONS/BOXES), AI generators often struggle with partial edge text, making this a low-severity suspect area for gibberish or malformed characters.

The reflections on the plastic wrapping of the cigarette pack are slightly soft and lack the sharp, chaotic specular highlights typical of crinkled cellophane, appearing somewhat 'smudged' or overly smooth.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically a lighter and not a similar rectangular object.
To verify the legibility and structural correctness of the prominent text, which is a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the rectangular body has sharp, continuous edges without melting into the background pack.
To assess the realism of the black and white grain and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Text legibility and kerning on the lighter body
Structural integrity of the spark wheel and flame guard
Boundary separation between the lighter and the cigarette pack
Realism of plastic reflections and shadows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text 'BUY YOUR OWN FUCKING LIGHTER'. AI models often fail to render long, specific phrases with correct spelling and spacing. Verify if the letters are distinct or if they bleed into each other. Also, check the geometry of the spark wheel; it should have distinct teeth, not a smooth or melted ridge.
